summary: feat(settings): adopt Nova semantics on auth flow pages
description:
Because:
- Auth pages and shared components set colors with raw utilities and dark: pairs.
- Nova's Figma shows pill-shaped, taller CTAs and violet accents.

This commit:
- Swaps exact pairs for semantic utilities, incl. body (bg-canvas text-default).
- Collapses other pairs onto semantic tokens under nova: in pages and shared components.
- Applies Figma's Terms text, "or" divider and AppLayout panel under nova:.
- Gives Nova CTAs the circle radius and cta-xl padding near Figma's 56px.
- Uses the accent for nav-active, progress, input-radio and focus-visible-default.
